title: AEOI - Incident KPIs
description: How fast does a declared incident get a first hypothesis and a mitigation, and what is waiting on a human?

panels.title: Open incidents now, by status
panels.description: Not time-filtered: everything still open, whenever it was declared.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS incidents FROM incident.incidents WHERE status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED') GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Time to first hypothesis (investigation start -> first hypothesis)
panels.description: Only investigations that produced a hypothesis are counted (count shown).

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p95, count(*) AS investigations FROM (SELECT extract(epoch FROM min(h.created_at) - i.started_at) AS s FROM orchestrator.investigations i JOIN incident.hypotheses h ON h.investigation_id = i.id WHERE $__timeFilter(i.started_at) GROUP BY i.id, i.started_at) t

panels.title: Time to mitigate by an approved action (declared -> executed), by severity
panels.description: From DECLARED (created_at), not detected_at: the smokes send a fixed historical detected_at. A mitigation set by hand (status PATCH) is not counted here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT inc.severity, count(*) AS incidents, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.s) AS p50_s, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.s) AS p95_s FROM incident.incidents inc JOIN (SELECT incident_id, extract(epoch FROM min(executed_at)) AS e FROM incident.approvals WHERE outcome = 'EXECUTED' GROUP BY incident_id) x ON x.incident_id = inc.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.e - extract(epoch FROM inc.created_at) AS s) m WHERE $__timeFilter(inc.created_at) GROUP BY inc.severity ORDER BY inc.severity

panels.title: Time to resolve (declared -> resolved), by severity
panels.description: Empty until incidents are resolved (the smokes rarely resolve one) - no data is the honest answer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity, count(*) AS incidents, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p50_s, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s) AS p95_s FROM (SELECT severity, extract(epoch FROM resolved_at - created_at) AS s FROM incident.incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) t GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity

panels.title: Approvals waiting on a human now
panels.description: Not time-filtered. An expired request becomes EXPIRED and leaves this list.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, incident_id, action, source, requested_at, expires_at, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - requested_at) / 60) AS waiting_min FROM incident.approvals WHERE decision IS NULL AND expires_at > now() ORDER BY requested_at

panels.title: Approval decisions: how many, how fast (requested -> decided)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN decision IS NOT NULL THEN decision WHEN expires_at > now() THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'EXPIRED (not marked yet)' END AS decision, coalesce(decider_role, '-') AS decider_role, count(*) AS approvals, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM decided_at - requested_at)) AS p50_s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'EXECUTED') AS executed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM incident.approvals WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
